verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own GitHub repo states the Nitrokey 3 firmware is fully open source (Rust, Trussed framework, dual Apache 2.0/MIT) and ships tagged, installable releases, so the core of the story holds for the Nitrokey 3 line. Openness is not shown across the whole product family, though: a hands-on user reports the Nitrokey HSM's on-device applet is not free/open source. The pack also has no evidence of an independent firmware audit. missing for 10: open-source firmware evidenced across all Nitrokey devices (the HSM applet is reported closed), independent third-party firmware audit reports, reproducible-build or verification evidence that shipped binaries match the published source.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the firmware is open source or independently audited, so I don't have to take the vendor's word for what runs on the device

citations.quote: This software is fully open source.
All software, unless otherwise noted, is dual licensed under Apache 2.0 and MIT license.
Nitrokey 3 firmware is open source in Rust WITH tagged, installable releases
The applet running inside is not free/open source
